name: One-round learner-state viable-action conditional sampling versus ordinary expert recovery

decision.stopped_route: Original unadapted3B likelihood ranking and temperature sweeps on existing expert-state successful-path pools. Do not activate either failed confirmation candidate.
decision.one_next_experiment: Test finite-set conditional action sampling on states actually visited by the adapted learner, with an actual learner-continuation train-only falsification gate and ordinary expert-recovery control.
decision.why: Two complete negative selector screens and a clean data/prompt audit undermine another ranking run on the same pools. This alternative addresses learner-induced states and reference staleness while retaining a falsifiable projection increment. It is not a claim that recovery or DAgger is new.

evidence.temperature1_support: 40 non-singleton pools have mean maximum mass0.8992 and median0.9884. A T=1 draw changes approximately4.033/60 tasks versus greedy in expectation. Another draw or temperature sweep is not a substantive rescue.
evidence.data_confound_audit: No detected cross-arm task/input-format or stale-history confound:60 identical task/initial contexts,1047 causal examples checked, canonical bytes and180 retained traces match native/pool origins. The negative result remains negative.
evidence.failure_audit_limit: Invalid/repeated actions motivate a hypothesis, not an established causal diagnosis. No current dev failure identity selects the next cohort or anchor.

source_report_correspondence.retained_core: Privileged future information defines a truly executable recovery constraint; a frozen learner distribution conditions on that finite feasible action set; ordinary action-only SFT learns the sampled labels. Every changed action and successor is obtained in the real simulator.
source_report_correspondence.changed_estimand: Local viable-action projection at learner-induced states, not exact-state BRP or full-path ECPS/MH. Different candidate actions may reach different actual states. Expert-success continuations only certify finite-pool viability.
source_report_correspondence.novelty_boundary: DAgger already addresses learner-induced state distributions. Only a gain over ordinary expert recovery on identical states and update budgets would support an incremental projection contribution. It would not establish publication novelty.

prior_mechanism_hypothesis.H1: At fixed learner-induced histories, some teacher-viable first actions are easier for the adapted learner to continue successfully than others. Conditional probability under that same frozen learner preferentially selects these recoverable actions.
prior_mechanism_hypothesis.H0: Reference probability among teacher-viable actions does not improve actual learner-continuation success or downstream task success versus uniform/expert labels.
prior_mechanism_hypothesis.why_existing_evidence_does_not_answer: Earlier selection acted on expert-origin successful paths and scored with the original base. It neither isolated labels at identical learner histories nor tested whether the learner can finish after the selected action.
prior_mechanism_hypothesis.reference_choice: Use the standard canonical-BC role, not a dynamic best-arm or checkpoint choice. Disclose that its dev result was already known when designing this new exploratory experiment. Adapted-versus-base scoring is descriptive, not a claimed isolated causal effect of adaptation.

roles: common initialization for three trained arms
frozen_start_policy.binding: Bind every final adapter/config/tokenizer/state byte through completed learning locks and model/runtime inventories before execution.
frozen_start_policy.student_protocol: Original causal task/history/current observation/admissible-command prompt; greedy generation;2048 context;64 action tokens including EOS;100 environment actions;seed20261012. No admissible decoding, task-text repair or object-number postprocessing at evaluation.

training_cohort.rule: Ordered set difference of train120 and the frozen same60 cohort:remaining10 tasks per family. These are training tasks, not held-out evidence. They were absent from the chosen same60 canonical adapter's SFT data.
training_cohort.anchors: States immediately after4,8,16 actual greedy learner actions, if still active:at most180 anchors. Run each whole original learner episode once. Already-terminated/unsupported slots remain explicit unavailable entries; do not replace tasks/timesteps.
training_cohort.records: Exact original task string, actual history including errors, current observation/commands, raw canonical state including elapsed_steps/moves, prefix actions, terminal status, game/metadata/model/source hashes.

candidate_pool.fixed_proposal: Include native planner first action. Include the recorded frozen learner next action if distinct, admissible and not information-only. Fill remaining slots from distinct admissible non-information-only commands ordered by SHA256(recovery_projection_v1_action_pool|relative_game|elapsed_steps|command). Neither likelihood nor downstream success chooses the8 proposed commands.
candidate_pool.information_only: Use existing gnrl.alfworld_env.information_only_action. Planner first action is retained even if information-only. Unsupported planner behavior is reported, not replaced.
candidate_pool.teacher: Existing native planner expert. Its arbitrary-prefix behavior must pass bounded preflight. No alternative LLM teacher or second planning algorithm in this version.
candidate_pool.execution: Seeded reset, exact learner-prefix replay, verify canonical state/observation/admissibles. Execute changed first action, then follow native planner from resulting actual state to original-goal success within original total100-action budget. Record fresh transitions throughout; never splice old expert suffix observations.
candidate_pool.viability: Retain a distinct command only when its fresh branch ends won=true under the unmodified original game within budget. Planner baseline action must itself have a successful certificate for an anchor to be eligible for all three arms. Keep all acquisition failures in reported denominators.
candidate_pool.lock: Finish and hash-lock all proposals, failures, successful certificates and costs before scoring or continuation comparisons. No expansion of low-yield pools.
candidate_pool.semantics: Original benchmark/PDDL success; preserve simulator abstractions. No claim of physical correctness or equal terminal states.
candidate_pool.planner_source_evidence: Parent read-only inspection reports planner recomputes from current PddlState after each step,including invalid actions. This supports implementation feasibility only;actual bounded CPU replay/invalid-action recovery smoke remains required before acquisition.

conditional_distribution_and_labels.formula: For certified finite commands C_h:q(a|h)=exp(log pi_BC(a+EOS|h))/sum_b_in_C_h exp(log pi_BC(b+EOS|h));T=1, no length normalization, clipping, temperature search or greedy replacement.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.scope: Precisely normalized distribution over this proposed, planner-certified finite action set. No claim of full successful-action support, unbiased path-space sampling or MH stationarity.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.expert_recovery: One native planner first-action label at each common eligible anchor. Necessary single-round DAgger-style recovery comparator.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.uniform_viable_recovery: One uniform command from same deduplicated C_h at each same anchor.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.reference_conditional_recovery: One q draw at each same anchor. Draw once, store uniform/CDF values; no redraw.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.draws: u=first64bits(SHA256(salt|relative_game|elapsed_steps))/2^64. Salts:recovery_projection_v1_uniform and recovery_projection_v1_conditional. Commands sorted by exact UTF-8 bytes for CDF.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.before_gate: Draw/freeze all three datasets before inspecting learner-continuation results. Q outcomes cannot filter anchors, select labels or change probabilities.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.student_visibility: Only original task, actual previous observations/actions, current observation/commands and selected action+EOS target. Teacher plan, future observations, state facts, success labels, scores and Q values never enter prompts.
conditional_distribution_and_labels.replay_validation: Independently reset/prefix-replay every retained candidate first action and compare actual next state/observation with its certificate. Any mismatch stops. Count reset/prefix costs.

train_only_diagnostic_gate.purpose: Test whether reference probability selects actions the actual learner can continue, rather than merely actions an oracle can rescue. No training/new held-out rollout before passing.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.rule: Before rollout,within each complementary training family sort10 identities by SHA256(recovery_projection_v1_diagnostic36|relative_game). Ranks0,1 use after4 actions;2,3 after8;4,5 after16. Six distinct tasks per family. No replacement of unavailable anchors.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.actual_Q: For EVERY retained command at each available fixed diagnostic anchor, independently reset/replay prefix,verify state,execute that command,then let frozen canonical BC act greedily to original total100-action horizon/termination. Q_h(a)=actual won. Never substitute planner success,score/NLL or critic estimates. At most288 learner branches.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.metrics: Vq=sum q(a)Q_h(a);Vu=mean Q_h(a);Ve=Q_h(planner_first_action). Average pairwise differences over all36 planned anchors. Already-terminal/unavailable/no-certified-expert slots contribute0 to differences because intervention is unavailable; preserve explicit status,never present these as observed failed Q episodes.
all_required: At least12/36 planned anchors have at least2 certified commands,covering at least4 families.
At least8 diagnostic anchors contain both successful and unsuccessful actual learner continuations. Otherwise probability-utility contrast is not identified.
Mean(Vq-Vu) over fixed36 slots is at least2/36 (approximately5.56 percentage points).
Mean(Vq-Ve) over fixed36 slots is at least0.
Frozen conditional labels differ from expert and uniform labels on at least12 eligible training anchors against each comparator. No redraw if degenerate.
All planned technical records complete;replay,prompt,hash and token checks have zero errors.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.threshold_status: Preregistered operational mechanism/futility criteria,not significance tests,powered estimates or guarantees of learning. Training continuation outcomes are not held-out benefit.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.secondary: Score original unadapted base on same locked C_h and report its q-weighted Q using the same executed branches. Fixed descriptive comparison only;cannot select reference/change labels/rescue failed gate.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.unblinding: Inspect complete36-slot diagnostic table only after all available candidate Q rollouts finish. Monitor technical status/counts only during execution.
train_only_diagnostic_gate.failure: Any scientific gate failure stops this version before training and new held-out evaluation. No lower threshold,new subset,temperature,checkpoint,horizon or seed. Preserve negative diagnostic.

missingness_contract.structural_unavailable: Only completed original collection terminal/no-admissible slots or completed planner search with no certified expert;Q values remain null,paired intervention differences explicitly0 on fixed36 denominator. Report counts by reason and diagnostic eligible-subset values descriptively.
missingness_contract.technical_missing: Exception,incomplete record,budget stop,hash/replay/token error,missing planned candidate branch:gate=null and complete=false,never a structural zero. Do not calculate a pass from the available prefix.
missingness_contract.estimand: Availability-weighted intervention increment across the fixed36 planned training slots,not the average Q or observed success rate of36 actually executed episodes.

conditional_training.initialization: Identical original3B plus frozen canonical final LoRA loaded trainable. Continue existing adapter weights with fresh identical AdamW. Do not stack an adapter or reuse prior optimizer state.
conditional_training.per_step: Exactly4 common original canonical BC examples and4 common eligible recovery anchors,interleaved BC0,recovery0,...,BC3,recovery3. Separate deterministic shuffles of349 BC indices and common anchor indices,seeds613300 and613301,reshuffle on wrap. Same index schedule all arms.
conditional_training.settings: lr0.0002,LoRA rank16/alpha32/dropout0.05,action-only token-weighted accumulation,bfloat16,AdamW weight_decay0,gradient clipping1,context2048/action64. Freeze code and exact per-arm token audits;match trained target totals/final step100 state.
conditional_training.matching: Same source histories,400+400 exposures and100 updates. Token counts may differ and must be reported;no padding/resampling. Equal updates are not equal total compute.
conditional_training.checkpoint: Final step100 only. Lock all three models before first research evaluation. No training-loss checkpoint choice or new iteration.

new_research_evaluation.status: Exploratory new seen-task evaluation,not confirmation or old dev24. Metadata-only manifest freeze before any new task observation/rollout and before acquisition begins.
new_research_evaluation.selection: Enumerate complete supported/solvable valid_seen inventory with existing frozen filters. Exclude every previously evaluated task and every task sharing its family/object/receptacle/device/scene recipe key,plus any train identity. Within family choose first8 by SHA256(recovery_projection_v1_research_seen48|relative_game). Freeze source universe,exclusions,selected game/metadata hashes. If any family has fewer8 eligible,STOP;no quota/split fallback.
new_research_evaluation.exposure_registry: Register all previous evaluation manifests,including both old/current dev24. Select by membership/metadata only,never outcomes. Audit task/semantic-key overlaps;disclose scene overlap with train/old dev. New seen tasks are not new-room generalization.
new_research_evaluation.unseen134: Remain unopened:zero unseen134 evaluations and no confirmation adoption.
new_research_evaluation.protocol: Greedy original prompt;environment_seed20261012;100 steps;context2048/action64;max_generated_tokens350000 per model;max_scored_tokens10000000;wall7200 seconds per model.
new_research_evaluation.primary: Full48-task paired success difference:reference_conditional minus expert_recovery. Secondary required contrast:minus uniform_viable. Frozen BC is acquisition-benefit context,not sole evidence of projection gain.
new_research_evaluation.practical_screen: Reference must gain at least3/48 successes over BOTH equally trained recovery controls and strictly exceed frozen BC. Exploratory practical screen,not p-value/confirmation. Report all4 counts,full48 table,paired gains/losses,6families and every scene with denominators.
new_research_evaluation.analysis: No independent-episode significance claim from correlated tasks/scenes and one seed. Report exact differences and heterogeneity. NLL/invalid-action rates are secondary and cannot replace success.
new_research_evaluation.complete_only: Complete/hash-lock all192 episodes before performance access. Any technical/budget incompleteness:all192 statuses,null outcomes,no partial comparison;retain whether unblinding began. No retry/favorable subset.
new_research_evaluation.after: Failure against either recovery control stops this likelihood-projection route for this ALFWorld setup. If recovery variants improve BC similarly,attribute gain to recovery supervision,not sampling. Positive screen supports only bounded exploratory incremental effect;no automatic seeds,unseen reopening or goal-completion claim.

finite_budgets.feasibility: Approximately0.5seconds per environment action makes diagnostic28800-step maximum about4GPU-hours,not the20-hour144000-step all180-anchor alternative. Timing is no guarantee;stage limit is capped by remaining global time. No post-outcome enlargement.
finite_budgets.accounting: Log all reset,prefix replay,failed planner,validation,learner-continuation,generation,scoring/training costs. Count env.step when started. Separate common acquisition/diagnostic research overhead from selector-specific scoring and cheaper deployable expert-only recovery. No equal-total-compute claim.
